This plot I rent grows beans, and beans do not need the white fertilizer — they feed the soil themselves, so I save that money for other things. I will put some manure from our animals if I can carry it, and I will plant the seed I kept from last year like my neighbors do. With my children helping we can manage most of the work, but at weeding time I may call one or two people for a few days.
